candidates.name: juvenile ossifying fibroma
support_spans: a 4.0×3.5 cm diffuse, well-defined, hard, nontender swelling on the right middle third of the face
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are consistent with a well-defined swelling in the right upper posterior tooth region.

candidates.name: fibrous dysplasia
support_spans: a provisional clinical diagnosis of juvenile ossifying fibroma was made, with fibrous dysplasia as a consideration
contradict_spans: the margin of the swelling was well-defined and well demarcated from the surrounding areas which was very much unlike FD whose margin is ill-defined and merges with the surrounding areas
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination results are partially consistent with fibrous dysplasia, but the well-defined margin of the swelling makes it less likely.
